title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (Switch 2) (NX2navi)
description: NX2navi is a static recompilation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 (game version 1.1.1) into a native x86-64 application for Windows, with a Vulkan renderer. (Tested by me 80% playable) *make sure ur device is pretty decent
